summary: Phase 1+2 backend testing complete. Added 12 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_phase2.py covering Voice TTS (Emergent OpenAI TTS), Physio-AI (Claude Sonnet 5), Solidarity Hub (mocked donations), Respect Map (aggregation), Blackout Snapshot, and auth-gating on all 7 new endpoints. Combined with 16 regression tests from iteration 1: 28/28 pytest cases pass (100%). One transient Cloudflare 502 on /api/ai/translate resolved on immediate retry — infrastructure flakiness, not code. Frontend login screen verified on mobile viewport (375x667) — renders correctly with all 4 language chips visible and both required testIDs (guardian-credit, google-signin-button) present.

minor.issue: One Cloudflare 502 observed during full-suite run; passed cleanly on retry. Likely upstream ingress flakiness, not backend.

ui_bugs.issue: Chips render correctly (Slovenčina, Čeština, English, Deutsch) but do NOT expose lang-chip-sk/cs/en/de testIDs — only visual/text selectors work. Iteration 1 report claimed these testIDs existed; they do not in the current build.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add testID='lang-chip-sk' | 'lang-chip-cs' | 'lang-chip-en' | 'lang-chip-de' to the four language chip Pressables in login.tsx for testability (chips work fine visually).
server.py is now 729 lines — starting to warrant a split (routes/, models/, services/).
TTS uses in-memory _tts_cache dict — will grow unbounded and reset on restart. Consider LRU + persistence for production.
OPTIONAL: Refactor repeated `authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None)` + manual get_current_user calls into FastAPI Depends(get_current_user) for DRY (14+ endpoints affected).
critical_code_review_comments: Voice TTS endpoint auth-checks with `await get_current_user(authorization)` but discards user — fine but note only the caller's identity is validated, no per-user rate limit or quota.
Respect Map aggregation is correct (weighted running average) and idempotent for tag deduplication via set().
Blackout snapshot returns emergency_profile even when empty ({}) — frontend must handle absent fields.
STT endpoint is intentionally MOCKED (documented in review_request) — not flagged as bug.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (login renders + 2/2 required testIDs; lang-chip testIDs missing)

seed_data_creation: Second seed user + session inserted in Mongo by test_phase2.py fixture (TEST_ prefix), torn down after module including campaigns, donations, providers, provider_reviews collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest files live: backend_test.py (Phase 1 — 16 tests) and test_phase2.py (Phase 2 — 12 tests). Both seed their own Mongo user+session (TEST_ prefix) and clean up. Voice TTS returns {key,url}; url is relative (/api/voice/tts/<key>.mp3) — prepend BASE_URL to fetch. Physio and AI translate hit Claude Sonnet 5 — allow up to 90s and expect occasional Cloudflare 502s (retry once). STT endpoint is MOCKED by design.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no code bugs found this iteration. Transient 502 on /api/ai/translate is Cloudflare ingress flakiness (Ray ID a2f999e59f98f8e2, cluster-10 preview) and cleared on retry within 5s.
